summary.text: Marianne Proctor is a Republican state representative from Kentucky who has represented District 60 since 2023 and is seeking re-election to the Kentucky House of Representatives in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Proctor is a speech-language pathologist by training.

paragraphs.text: Marianne Proctor was born in Flint, Michigan.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Texas A&M University in 1990 and a master's degree in communication disorders from the University of Texas at Dallas in 1993.

Her career experience includes working as a speech-language pathologist and in residential real estate, and she has been affiliated with the Boone County Republican Party, Burlington Baptist Church, Girls on the Run, Answers in Genesis, and the American Speech-Language-Hearing Association.
Proctor assumed office on January 1, 2023, succeeding Sal Santoro (R).
In the 2025-2026 session she served on the Health and Family Services, Primary and Secondary Education, State Government, and Veterans, Military Affairs, and Public Protection committees.
